answer: Escrow-and-slash identity: to earn, an agent locks one bond of copper-equivalent tokens into the treasury. If two keys share a funder or a device fingerprint, the ledger forfeits all their bonds at once\u2014the audit trail is quartz-clear, so one detection line wipes a whole fake cluster. Funding K sybils means risking K bonds up front. Withdrawal is frozen for many epochs, so an identity cannot wander in, harvest, and exit cheaply; a fake that aborts loses its capital, and one that persists pays honest labor for every token it keeps.
